This document authors three `ratelimit` fields (former OQ-traffic-management-and-resilience-1 options (a) and (c)), submitted to the Configuration model for registration
limits[].perNodeCeiling (integer, 1 to `requests`; unset): each Node's bucket capacity and refill per `window` (proposed, OQ-1 registration)
limits[].burst (integer, 0 to `requests`; default `requests`): τ = `burst` × `window` / `requests`, so a window admits `requests` + `burst` (proposed, OQ-1 registration)
config.localOnly (boolean; default `false`) (proposed, OQ-1 registration)
